title.narrative: Reducing vulnerability in Lao PDR: Advancing social protection and labour rights and entitlements in the coffee and tea sectors of Lao PDR (SoLaR)

description.narrative: The Action intends to promote labor rights and improve access to social protection coverage and occupational safety and health for coffee and tea sectors workers in Lao PDR. In particular, it will aim: to extend and improve social protection and Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) delivery at district level in the coffee and tea sectors; and, to support workers to be better organized and empowered to promote and protect their labor rights.
